section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the procedure for a single study conducted in March 2010 recruiting women from the United States through online platforms including Internet forums, list serves, and Facebook. Participants were recruited to include women of varying body sizes and levels of body appreciation, with data collected online via an initial questionnaire covering sociodemographics, health indicators, body appreciation, and sexual health, followed by a 35-day daily diary component.
